context.person: A person using a museum booking site
context.user_goal: Select another currently available time and complete checkout separately.

product_state.preceding_state: The selected 11:00 AM entry sold out while the visitor was entering guest details.
product_state.current_state: No tickets were reserved. Guest details remain in the form.
known_facts: Guest details remain in the form.
The 11:30 AM and 12:00 PM times are available now.
Choosing another time does not submit payment.
forbidden_claims: The museum is sold out all day.
The alternative times are guaranteed until checkout.

challenge: Rewrite the inline error and recovery control so the person can understand museum entry time sold out, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Leave booking without losing the entered guest details during this session.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The original time cannot be purchased.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Select another currently available time and complete checkout separately.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
